notes.title: Patch 1.03 is available.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!!

New patch is ready

Here are the chages:

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game could get stuck after purchasing consumables at special shop on last stage.
[*]You could get a windmill encounter going to a  battlefield.
[*]Option to learn alchemy is now properly indicated at height 3.
[*]Kobold slaver quest was cancelled instead of completed.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dancing blades cooldown increased from 5 to 18.
[*]Moved wisps encounter so that it only appears in the forest.
[*]Unlock points needed has been reduced a lot.
[*]Unlock points obtained has been sligthly reduced and simplified. Now they only depend on how far you get on the run.
[/list]

[h1]Functionality[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you can start casting an spell while being hit. We noticed that it can be frustrating to have casting interrupted.
[/list]

We have a new patch ready. A little bit later than expected, sorry about that.

Here are the chages:

[list]
[*]Encounters could be skipped with a specific use of menus.

notes.title: Patch 9: Fairness improvement

Hi everyone!!
We have a new patch. This time we have focused in changing some unfairness in the game. We will keep thinking about making the game fair. This is just a first step.

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
     [*]We have added passive abilities to the warrior and mage. You can have more HP, damage, movement speed, armour, mana... You can find this new abilities in the stone circles.
    [*]New item. Potion of life. An improved potion of health.
    [*]New Item. Health belt. Increases you max HP.
    [*]Berserker ability has been reworked. Damage boost for a while and defensive penalties, and after that, bigger defensive penalties. Use it to finish off your enemies!!
    [*]We added an introduction to the first level.
[/list]

[h1]Functionality[/h1]
[list]
    [*]When a menuitem takes you to a Karma roll, now you have a tooltip that shows the amount of charms of each type that you have.
    [*]Now you have separate savefiles for each profile.
    [*]Buying in shops has been improved. Now you buy with one click.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Food penalty can't reduce your party size to 1. Heroes will only leave the group if you have 3 or more.

    [*]Now inns have a little more food. 
    [*]Potion of health now heals a percentage of your max HP.
    [*]Now spectre is not totally immune to physical attacks an he removes dodge when he attacks. 
    [*]Sleeping in the wilderness now takes the same time as sleeping at the Inn.
   [*]Some abilities don't affect large enemies or bosses (Net, iron trap, charm). In some cases the upgrade will affect large enemies and/or bosses
   [*]Red cleric now has an starting "free" ability (summon water elemental)
[/list]
  
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
    [*]After restoring a game all buildings could appear on the top left of the map. This is fixed.
    [*]Some options in the goblin outpost should only be available if you have good standing with the goblins.
[/list]
